$comment: 仕様資材。アプリ未実装。本人所有の履歴・用途境界を維持し、実験は無効化可能。型検査は意味支持・認証・原子性を保証しない。

MemoryDraft.$comment: W30-02: epistemic_kind records origin, not review or objective truth. Adoption preserves origin, source attribution and dependencies; content correction requires a new revision.

ChangeRecord.$comment: W30-02: state is the change workflow (proposed/accepted/rejected), not lifecycle, deployment or authorization. author records the proposer, not the approver. A model-authored proposal can later be accepted by a separately authenticated owner; this response shape cannot authenticate that transition.

MemoryRevision.$comment: W30-02: review_state=confirmed_by_user is retained as the existing wire spelling. Do not silently rename it to ArtifactView.review_status=user_adopted. approved_by.kind=user is a DTO constraint, not authenticated owner authority. Adoption does not change content.epistemic_kind or remove required_features.

Snapshot.$comment: W30-02: content_head, derivation_generation, policy_version, erasure_epoch, learner_version and feature_epoch are separate version coordinates, not review/lifecycle/rollout/authorization states. Replaying an old snapshot does not restore revoked permission or erased content.

DerivationRequest.$comment: W30-02: the producer submits ai_hypothesis content only. review_status, lifecycle, recorded_lane, producer_feature and required_features are not producer-set request fields. The trusted core computes the view and all dependency restrictions; another model or adoption cannot launder the origin.

ArtifactView.$comment: W30-02: review_status, lifecycle and recorded_lane are independent axes. This stored/projection shape can describe stale or erased states; schema validity never authorizes returning erased payloads or ordinary use of stale/retracted content. recorded_lane describes the recording lane, not current Deployment. Adoption changes review metadata only and retains content, producer_feature and required_features.

GateDecision.$comment: W30-02: outcome and basis describe one bound use decision, not adoption, truth, feature tier or deployment. Neither a QualityAssessment continue recommendation nor enabled FeatureControl grants allow.

DeploymentView.$comment: W30-02: stage describes the current feature/producer/purpose deployment; suspended is a deployment stop state, not an ArtifactView.recorded_lane value. Promotion does not rewrite the recorded origin or adopt content.

FeatureControlView.$comment: W30-02: state controls opt-in/stop, independently of feature tier, design agreement, implementation progress, content review, Deployment stage and Gate outcome. Re-enabling does not restore past live deployment automatically.
